resources.string: Warns you when WakeNudge could not set up an alarm, so you do not oversleep because of it.
Sounds the alarm by itself in the rare case WakeNudge could not start its alarm service.

plurals.name: notif_scheduling_problem_text
plurals.item: Android refused to set up %d alarm. Open WakeNudge and check Alarm health.
Android refused to set up %d alarms. Open WakeNudge and check Alarm health.

resources.string: On %1$s: %2$s Alarms set up this way can ring a little late, or not be shown as the next alarm in the status bar. Restarting the phone often clears it.
On %1$s the alarm could not play the sound it was set to and used a fallback: %2$s. Pick a different sound for the alarm, or check that the file still exists.

The alarm stopped unexpectedly while it was ringing on %1$s (the alarm screen or the sound service stopped working). WakeNudge started it again right away, but please send a support report from this screen.
Battery Saver is on. Alarms still ring, but timers, heads-up notices and the bedtime reminder can arrive late.
